method: battingAge = PA-weighted mean of each player-stint's age (looked up from build-roster-age.mjs's cache by personId+season+group) using ONLY plate appearances/innings accrued through July 31 that season, i.e. before the trade deadline; pitchingAge = IP-weighted, same window. *Relative fields are each team's pre-deadline age minus that SEASON's own pre-deadline league-wide weighted average — NOT the full-season league average from roster-age.json.
